messages:
Maya: Quick design review — proposing a compact 'mini panel' that sits above the heatmap to surface p50 / p95 / p99 + tiny sparkline. ideas? Sam: Love it. main worry: does it push the heatmap off-screen on smaller viewports? Diego: Mobile could be tight. Maybe default collapsed on < 900px? :mobile_phone: Maya: Collapsible by default works. thinking of moving the time-range preset into the mini header to save vertical space. Olivia: Copy nit — use consistent short labels: 'Last 30m' vs '30 minutes'. prefer '30m' or '30 min' for density. Sam: Short labels win for glanceability, but add a tooltip with the full phrase for a11y. Maya: noted. Accessibility: tabbable focus on each metric, p95 badge contrast currently fails AA on light theme. Diego: Can we reuse existing metrics chip component to reduce dev debt? Maya: Prototype sketch -> Maya: ```
p50 40ms p95 120ms p99 450ms
``` Sam: That looks clean. Another question: where do sampling controls live? We need an 'auto-sample' / 'full-scan' toggle, otherwise long-range queries hammer the backend. Diego: Suggestion: keep sampling control hidden in the expanded details and surface a mode pill when sampling is active. Or show it only when QPS > threshold. Olivia: A11y: sparkline must not be the only conveyance — add SR text like 'p95 120ms, trend +5% over previous period'. Maya: Agreed — SR text element + aria-live when metrics update. Maya: UI debate: heatmap bucket resolution — fixed 10 buckets vs adaptive resolution. Adaptive hides detail over long ranges. Sam: For large ranges, adaptive makes sense. But expose a 'Resolution' control in advanced settings for power users. Diego: Engineering note: API needs to accept optional resolution param; default null -> server picks. Maya: UX copy for control: 'Data resolution' with tooltip: 'Higher resolution = more precise view, may increase compute'. Olivia: 'Resolution' might confuse some PMs — 'Detail level' or 'Granularity' alternatives? Sam: I'm leaning 'Resolution' (short & technical) plus tooltip. Also propose keyboard shortcut 'r' to open resolution menu. Maya: Visual affordance: when sampling occurs, visually mark sampled buckets (thin stripe at top + lowered opacity) to communicate approximation. Diego: Implementation sketch: CSS class `.sampled { opacity: 0.62; border-top: 2px solid #f0ad4e; }`. We can animate on toggle. Sam: Also add a transient toast: 'Query mode: sampled — results approximate' whenever sampling mode toggles. Olivia: Make the toast role="status" for screen readers and ensure it doesn't trap focus. Maya: Where does p95 live — inline badge for quick glance or open modal with historical breakdown on click? Diego: Inline badge for glance, click opens modal with historic percentiles & distribution. Sam: Timeline: design mock by Friday, engineering feasibility review Monday, small spike Tuesday. Maya: I'll update Figma, add a11y notes and copy variants. deploy-bot: Design assets committed to branch feature/mini-latency at commit 1769998922. Olivia: I'll run contrast and axe checks once designs are pushed. Maya: Thanks team :heart:
